look_here_first: FIRST flip a mid-stem leaf and magnify its fine netted veins: S. praealtum usually has a conspicuous pattern of small approximately equidimensional AREOLES below; above the blade is often WAXY, relatively firm, with margins sometimes rolled under (revolute). Check progressive reduction of leaves toward the flowering panicle and phyllary profile. Do NOT force ID from peduncle leafy-bract counts: FNA genus key and two species accounts disagree on opposite numbers.
